text:
Noah: Short notice ask 00hrs: Marketing wants a live demo in ~36h and needs ~12 H100s in eu-west2 for a 6h window. Can we surface options?

Priya: Are they expecting reserved performance or is spot/marketplace ok?

Noah: Pref reserved for demo stability but can accept marketplace burst if cost/time OK.

Sophie: Quick pool look: eu-west2 H100s total = 40, reserved long-term = 28, ephemeral free = 4. So we don't have 12 free without reallocations.

Ben: We have two practical approaches: 1) rapid marketplace allocation (instant but ~2x cost) for full 12, OR 2) reserve 8 from vendor (needs PO) + 4 marketplace burst. Option 2 lowers cost but needs procurement lead time.

Kai: Procurement lead for hard reservation is usually 24-72h. Not great for 36h window. Marketplace seems fastest.

Priya: If marketplace is acceptable, we should confirm network/placement constraints (AZ affinity? private endpoint?). Demo needs low-latency to our staging cluster.

Sophie: If we do marketplace burst, I'll pin 4 ephemeral nodes in eu-west2-b and ask infra to NAT them to staging. The rest can be allocated across eu-west2-b/c.

Noah: Good. Anyone know immediate cost delta? 

Ben: Marketplace quote I saw yesterday: H100 burst ~ $1.90/token-hour equivalent (approx). For 12 * 6h that's ~ $137. (rough calc, will send spreadsheet).

procurement-bot: PROC-ALERT: For hard reservations, submit PO template: https://intranet.redwood/po-template. Soft PO allowed for tentative holds.

Priya: Can we do a soft PO to hold 8 and fill rest from marketplace? That would give partial SLA and lower overall spend.

vendor-bot: VB-11011: Marketplace allocation available now in eu-west2. Hard reservation (vendor) can hold 8 with soft PO but needs signoff within 12h to secure allocation.

Kai: Soft PO + marketplace mix seems safest. Soft PO buys time; marketplace covers immediate demo.

Noah: Ok plan: Sophie + Ben -> run marketplace allocate for 12 (demo window) and tag them. Priya -> prepare soft PO and loop in finance. Kai -> verify networking (private endpoint) and update staging routing.

Sophie: Marketplace CLI I'll run now: 
```bash
vendor-cli allocate \ 
  --region eu-west2 \ 
  --gpu h100-v2 \ 
  --count 12 \ 
  --start "2026-03-23T10:00:00Z" \ 
  --duration 6h \ 
  --tags demo,marketing
```
Will tag the instances and stage them under /staging/demo.

Ben: I'm dropping a quick cost sheet in the ticket INFRA-9056 and pinging finance.

Priya: PO draft up, sending to @Finance and CC @Noah. Soft PO wording: hold 8 H100 eu-west2-b/c pending final invoice.

procurement-bot: PROC-ALERT: Soft PO template sent. Reference: SOFT-PO-2026-03.

vendor-bot: VB-11011: Marketplace allocation confirmed for 12 H100 in eu-west2. Instances will be ready in ~8 minutes.

Sophie: Instances up and SSHable. Kicking smoke tests against staging.

Kai: Networking check - private endpoint NATed, latency to staging < 12ms. Good to go.

Noah: Awesome. Action items: Priya finish soft PO (12:15), Ben post cost in INFRA-9056, Sophie keep instances tagged and teardown at +7h, Kai monitor routing. Thanks team.

Ben: Quick FYI for future: if we expect repeat demos we should add a small reserved buffer in eu-west2 to avoid marketplace premiums.

Noah: Agreed. Will follow up in planning sync. :thumbsup:
